summary: Read a builtin Map key with SameValueZero-equivalent matching and return undefined when absent.
caveats: C# Dictionary.TryGetValue default(TValue) is not equivalent to JavaScript undefined.
NaN keys match NaN; -0 and +0 designate the same key.

tests.name: NaN and absent semantics
tests.input: const m=new Map([[NaN,1]]); console.log(m.get(NaN), m.get('missing') === undefined);
